description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 28.02.2022 to 06.03.2022
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically modifying how financial calculations are performed for import/export transactions. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
